webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: A webhook sends credential events to a receiver. The server signs every request with the secret in the named environment variable.

create.title: Add a webhook
create.urlHint: An https address of a host that the operator admits in WEBHOOK_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
create.secretEnvHint: The name of the environment variable on the server that holds the signing secret, such as WEBHOOK_SECRET_RECEIVER.

errors.urlInvalid: Enter a complete address without user name or password, such as https://hooks.example.org/credentials.
errors.urlHttps: The address must start with https://.
errors.urlTooLong: The address may have at most 255 characters.
errors.hostNotAllowed: The server does not admit this host. The operator lists the admitted hosts in WEBHOOK_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
errors.secretPrefix: The name starts with WEBHOOK_SECRET_ and continues with capital letters, digits or underscores.
errors.secretUnset: The server has no value for this variable. Set it in the environment of the server first.
